text: Badgerow Avenue, east of Pape Avenue is a residential street with two-way traffic. Residents contacted my office requesting parking changes on their street to improve access to parking for local residents. My office has polled the street and 63% of residents support these parking changes.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Authorized the extension of the overnight on-street permit parking hours on the odd side of Badgerow Avenue, between Pape Avenue and the east end of Badgerow Avenue from 12:01 a.m. to 7:00 a.m., seven days a week to 12:01 a.m. to 7:00 a.m., seven days a week, and 4:00 p.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday.
